entities.name: Parma
entities.description: A cold theocratic kingdom among the northern Domains of Dominaria, neighbouring Keld on Icehaven.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Land founded by Keldons driven from Parma by the cold.

entities.name: Icehaven
entities.description: Continent on which Parma and Keld lie.

entities.name: Northern Paladins
entities.description: Paladins of Parma who spread its central teaching through the Domains.

entities.name: Frost Giants
entities.description: Inhabitants of the cold land of Parma.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: People driven from Parma at the time of the Brothers' War who founded Keld and learned fire magic.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Keldon warlord who led a host to Parma to kill ice creatures and lessen Keld's frost.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War during which Keldons fled Parma.

events.summary: At the time of the Brothers' War, Keldons are driven from Parma by the cold and found Keld.
events.quote: At the time of the Brothers' War , Keldons were driven from Parma by the cold.

events.summary: Parma conflicts with Radha, who leads Gathans and Keldon survivors there to kill ice creatures, then returns to Keld.
events.quote: After her campaign, she returned to Keld.

relations.quote: The cold land is home to the Northern Paladins and Frost Giants .
eventually came into conflict with Radha and the folk of Keld and Skyshroud
